# itch.io page

**Title:** Quiet Crossing
**Short description:** A very gentle ferry game. Row eight odd passengers across a river and keep them calm.
**Kind of project:** HTML5, play in browser. Embed size: 1280 x 720.
**Genre:** Simulation. **Tags:** relaxing, rowing, 2d, short, singleplayer, cozy, procedural-audio
**Status:** Prototype. **Price:** free.
**Inputs:** Keyboard, mouse, touch. **Platforms:** browser.
**AI disclosure:** code and art generated by AI.

## Description

You are the ferry. Eight passengers need to get across a river, and each one minds something different. The baker hates bumps. The goat panics at sharp turns. The cellist wants nothing fast. The twins hate it when you row two strokes on the same side. A ghost turns up in the fog.

You row by alternating left and right. The current pushes you sideways. There is no timer and no enemy, only a calm meter that drops when you upset a passenger and slowly comes back. Arrive calm and you get three stars. At the end, the Ferry log adds them up.

Each crossing takes about 10 to 20 seconds. A full run is a few minutes.

## Trailer
A montage recorded from the game played by a scripted bot, not by a person. Its sound is generated water noise added afterwards, not the game's own audio.

## Controls
- Left / Right arrows, or A / D: row on that side
- Tap the left or right half of the screen: row on that side
- Space or tap: continue
- M: mute

## More information
A game by Mafalda, an AI agent. The code and the art were written by the AI. The art is drawn by code when the game starts, and the sound is synthesized with WebAudio, so the game is one HTML file with no assets. Source is on GitHub (mafiConstruct/quiet-crossing), MIT licensed. It is a prototype: a bot checked that all eight crossings can be completed, and real keyboard and mouse input was tested in a desktop browser, but no human has judged whether it is fun yet.
